accepted_decisions.summary: CodeWiki Runtime becomes the daemon-capable orchestration owner for software-development compiler loops.
Pi Code is CodeWiki's primary runtime foundation dependency, not merely one harness adapter.
CodeWiki may add pluggable model/runtime policy above the Pi Code foundation only through explicit support/capability contracts.
Daemon jobs/runs record execution attempts and must not replace roadmap tasks, builds, validation reports, or Git/content proof.
Gateway fail/block keeps the same job/loop active or blocked; gateway pass is the safe boundary to enqueue the next compiler loop.
Daemon runtime architecture becomes a high-priority decision/planning cohort before broad namespace/lineage work.

roadmap_changes: High-priority planning sprint should be created from this decision before TASK-059/TASK-060 implementation.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Runtime nomenclature section and file-structure rules now make src/runtime the sole CodeWiki Runtime owner and mark domain runtime filenames as migration targets.
Runtime and API docs now state daemon pass-boundary continuation with build/validation refs and fail/block same-loop behavior.
Runtime/API docs now state Pi Code is the primary runtime foundation dependency and future runtime/model plug points require explicit contracts.
Runtime docs and component map now include daemon jobs/runs, attempts, heartbeats, block reasons, and build/validation refs without replacing roadmap truth.
Decision build records roadmap reprioritization requirement for planning sprint before TASK-059/TASK-060.
Durable research note captures OpenClaw and Hermes source citations and CodeWiki-specific principles before implementation.

product_impact: Future CodeWiki users should need less manual intervention between compiler loops because daemon jobs can resume from durable build/validation refs.
Future UI/TUI surfaces should expose pending semantic diff approvals and daemon job/runs clearly.
system_impact: Pi Code foundation dependency is explicit.
Daemon job/run store and pass-boundary scheduler become planned system work.
Runtime/model support contracts become required before non-Pi execution backends operate CodeWiki.

assumptions: Pi Code remains available as a package dependency/foundation for CodeWiki runtime work.
Future runtime/model plug points can be designed without committing to a non-Pi implementation in the first daemon slice.
Current TASK-057 implementation closure still requires fresh validation before task close.
non_goals: Do not turn CodeWiki into a general-purpose chat gateway.
Do not copy Hermes Kanban as CodeWiki's roadmap truth.
Do not support non-Pi runtimes before a support contract and test harness exist.
Do not let daemon jobs bypass decision/planning/implementation/validation/publication gates.

roadmap: High-priority planning sprint should be created from this decision before TASK-059/TASK-060 implementation.
